description: task-planner skill thresholds — all mutable numbers live here

max_vc.description: Minimum Verification Contract items per plan (Std 44)

min_verification_per_phase.description: Minimum V-N checks bound to each phase (Std 45)

retry_count.description: Max retries on same V-N FAIL before escalating to user (Std 42)

max_tool_calls_before_refresh.description: Tool calls threshold before re-reading task_plan.md (Std 10)

delegation_rate_floor.description: Minimum ratio of subagent-executed Phases at final verification; below floor or non-whitelisted main-process reasons caps outcome at PARTIAL (Rule 25.4)

delegation_enforce.description: 执行期委派门控档位：enforce=exit2 阻断主进程白名单外 Write/Edit；warn=仅注入警告并计数

interaction_mode.description: 交互模式（Rule 28）：ask=关键决策点(D1-D6)给选项供用户选择；silent=静默自主决策并登记静默决策清单(Decisions Made 表 silent: 前缀行)供交付复核。解析优先级: env TASK_PLANNER_INTERACTION_MODE > 计划配置表 interaction_mode > 本键 > 默认 ask；D6 硬停点(连续失败 STOP/drift BLOCKED/Q3/破坏性操作确认)两模式一致不可豁免

dispatch_contract_enforce.description: Agent() 派发契约守卫档位（Rule 22.4c，scripts/check-dispatch.sh）：enforce=prompt 缺当前计划三文件绝对路径/返回字段名(status:/acceptance:/checkpoint:)/subagent-state 检查点路径时 exit 2 阻断并列出缺项；warn=放行+告警计数；off=跳过。无活跃计划或解析异常一律放行（fail-open）

content_quality_enforce.description: v063 内容质量门控档位：enforce=内容型任务(writing/research/publish)终验前强制过 AI 化 10 条清单+五维评分卡≥4.0(references/methodology.md Q3/Q4)，不达标阻断交付；warn=注入警告并计数登记；off=不启用。默认 warn（观察期）

fmea_enforce.description: v063 规划期 FMEA 预演档位：enforce=RPN>100 的 Phase 无预设兜底登记=计划无效(attest 机械校验，后续轮)；warn=注入警告；off=不启用。默认 warn（观察期）

skill_collab_enforce.description: 协同技能接管评估严格度（task-v066，Rule 22.3.3，references/skill-collaboration.md）：off=跳过移交评估与 22.3.3；warn=提醒性评估（命中触发矩阵提示移交、22.3.3 评估记录不强制）；enforce=计划期命中触发矩阵须登记不移交理由方可继续、22.3.3 未评估禁止 ⑤AskUser/STOP；三档均流程层执行无 hook 校验，enforce 档语义预留。细则见 references/skill-collaboration.md

knowledge_brief_enforce.description: 任务知识简略要点(knowledge-brief)严格度（task-v067）：off=跳过 brief 产出与引用检查；warn=提醒性（plan-writer 产出职责+材料包引用 brief 锚点为提醒,不阻断）；enforce=计划交付时 brief 缺失或五段空壳(§2/§3 无真实条目)禁止交付、派发材料包未引用 brief 锚点告警阻断；三档均流程层执行无 hook 校验,enforce 档语义预留；细则见 templates/knowledge-brief.md 与 companion/agents/plan-writer.md knowledge_brief 契约行

hook_self_heal_enforce.description: 环境级中断自愈严格度（task-v068）：off=停用全部自愈分支（plan-created 哨兵兜底清除/PostToolUse 自动重锁/check-delegation observe 节流,退回旧行为）；warn=自愈生效且每次自愈留 stderr 痕迹；enforce=预留（语义=自愈失败升级为阻断）；sid 护栏恒在（非本会话编辑不触发自动重锁,仍报 TAMPERED）。当前 hook 脚本尚未读取该键,warn 为默认行为；off 档接读取与 enforce 档升级语义留后续轮

vc_gate_enforce.description: 终验 VC/V-N 门控档位（goal-gate.md 规 1/2，task-v065 T-3 V-9，check-complete.sh VC-GATE 段）：校验 task_plan.md VC 表 ≥ max_vc(默认 5) 条且每个 Phase 段 V-N 映射 ≥ min_verification_per_phase(默认 2) 条（映射目标须为已定义 VC 编号，映射仅记在 V-P.N 段内）；warn=缺失仅 stderr 警告不阻断 / enforce=缺失阻断 complete(exit 1) / off=关闭。档位解析优先级: env TASK_PLANNER_VC_GATE_ENFORCE > 本键 > 解析失败 fail-open warn（默认观察期）

rescue_chain_enforce.description: 失败挽救链路门控档位（task-v065 F-1，scripts/check-rescue-chain.sh）：Handoff 登记表 failed/timeout 行必须有 rescue 档位留痕 + checkpoint 路径且 subagent-state 检查点文件存在；enforce=违规阻断终验 / warn=仅警告 / off=关闭。默认 warn（观察期）

provider_fallback.description: Provider 类失败后主动 Scaling 改派（task-v055-fallback，Rule 22.3.1）：探测备用通道 + 生成变体 agent + 零消耗改派决策

enabled.description: 总开关；false 时 subagent-fallback.sh next 恒 escalation

variant_types.description: 生成 -fb 变体的高频 subagent_type 列表（逗号分隔）

fallback_slugs.description: fallback 模型 slug 有序表（裸 slug，跨机器可携带；probe/bind 按本机 ~/.zcode/v2/config.json provider 表解析实际 uuid）

probe_timeout_ms.description: 单通道 1-token 探测 curl -m 秒数（ms）；默认 20000 覆盖冷启动首连（实测 agnes 通道冷启动 >10s）

template_priority.description: Template search order: project-level first, then built-in fallback

todo_sync_interval_calls.description: Tool calls threshold before PostToolUse hook emits a native-Todo sync reminder (see references/todo-sync.md)

plan_update_interval_minutes.description: Max allowed age of task_plan.md before PostToolUse hook forces a plan-doc write-back reminder; also check-doc-sync.sh default

autonomous_resume.description: Enable autonomous continuation at plan-resume trigger points (Rule 24.5). When true, plan-resume auto-pushes the next pending Phase without waiting for explicit user confirmation.

stale_remind_cooldown_calls.description: After a stale-plan reminder, suppress further stale reminders for this many tool calls (anti-nag cooldown)

findings_stale_minutes.description: Max allowed age of findings.md before PostToolUse hook emits a [plan-compass] backfill reminder (Rule 19.7)

compass_escalate_after.description: Emit escalated [plan-compass] warning after this many consecutive stale reminders with no file update (Rule 19.7 escalation)

progress_stale_minutes.description: Max allowed age of progress.md before PostToolUse hook emits a [plan-compass] action-log reminder (Rule 19.7)

prompt_note_interval.description: UserPromptSubmit [plan-note] throttle: inject on 1st prompt of a session, then every Nth prompt

subagent.description: Subagent dispatch scaling thresholds — all mutable numbers live here (all mutable numbers live here principle)

max_per_phase.description: Max subagent dispatches per Phase; >max → refactor into more Phases or AskUser

retry_limit.description: Max retries for a single subagent task before escalating to AskUser (Rule 21.4)

max_files_per_dispatch.description: Max files a single subagent dispatch can touch (Rule 21.1)

max_lines_per_dispatch.description: Max lines a single subagent dispatch can touch (Rule 21.1)

step_max_files.description: Max files a single S-unit dispatch can touch — one tier tighter than max_files_per_dispatch (Rule 21.1b)

step_max_lines.description: Max lines a single S-unit dispatch can touch (Rule 21.1b)

step_max_minutes.description: Max estimated duration (minutes) of a single S-unit; exceeding → split further, NOT upgrade model (Rule 21.1b / 22.3 ②)

prompt_max_chars.description: Max chars of one dispatch prompt — small-model short-context budget; inject only path + ≤10-line summary per S-unit (Rule 22.4 field ⑨)

timeout_by_type.description: Timeout in minutes by subagent type; dispatch must enforce this limit (Rule 21)

context_hygiene_enforce.description: v069 上下文与工作文件主动维护档位（Rule 29）：enforce=Phase complete 后/会话恢复时强制运行 check-context-hygiene.sh + plan-hygiene.sh，退场/归档建议 exit 1 即阻断进入下一 Phase；warn=注入 [context-hygiene] 提醒并计数，主进程可自主决定是否执行；off=不启用。默认 warn（观察期）

plan_archive_age_days.description: plan-hygiene.sh 归档年龄阈值（天）：completed 任务目录 mtime 超过 N 天 → 建议迁入 plans/archive/；仅 mv 文件移动，无数据丢失；脚本默认 --dry-run 展示清单，--execute 需手动确认（Rule 29.4）

plan_hygiene_enforce.description: v069 工作文件整理档位（Rule 29.4）：enforce=plan-hygiene.sh --execute 前强制 --dry-run 展示清单并记录到 progress.md；warn=仅提醒；off=不启用。与 context_hygiene_enforce 独立控制，可单独开关
